modalDetails: This means the property is managed with the correct legal structure under Cyprus property law. Decisions, records, responsibilities and management actions are handled in a documented way, giving the Management Committee and residents a clearer and safer framework.

All property funds remain connected to the property and are not mixed with other buildings or company operating money. This protects transparency, improves accountability and makes it easier for the Management Committee to see how money is collected, held and used.

Monthly invoices are issued on a fixed schedule, so residents know when payments are due and the property has predictable cash flow. This supports standing orders, advance payments and better planning for maintenance, utilities and shared expenses.

Residents and the Management Committee communicate through dedicated WhatsApp or Viber groups created for the property. This makes announcements, scheduled works, payments and operational updates easier to follow, more transparent and faster to manage.

aboutPage.metaTitle: About Neurora Property Management | Cyprus Property Management
aboutPage.metaDescription: Learn how Neurora Property Management brings structure, transparency, communication, and control to apartment buildings and residential complexes across Cyprus.

hero.subtitle: Neurora Property Management was created for buildings and residential complexes that need more than basic administration. We bring a clear operating system to shared properties, combining communication, financial visibility, maintenance coordination, and documented procedures.

intro.title: A management partner for properties that need clarity.
intro.body: We work with Management Committees, owners, residents, and developers to replace informal arrangements with a structured management system. Every property is handled with clear communication, documented decisions, organized records, and full visibility over how the property operates.

method.title: The Neurora method
method.body: Our work is built on a simple principle: the property should remain in control of its money, its records, and its decisions. Neurora provides the operating structure, coordination, follow-up, and daily management needed to keep everything moving properly.

properties.title: Different properties. One structured standard.
properties.subtitle: From established apartment buildings to new developments and properties with operational issues, the goal is the same: replace confusion with a clear system.

standard.title: Built to protect trust between owners, residents, and the Management Committee.
standard.subtitle: The Neurora standard focuses on clear records, protected funds, predictable billing, and direct communication from day one.

cta.title: Ready to bring structure to your property?
cta.body: Tell us about your apartment building or residential complex and we will prepare a clear proposal based on its real needs.

howItWorksPage.metaTitle: Neurora Operating System | Neurora Property Management
howItWorksPage.metaDescription: Explore the Neurora Operating System, combining the full management process with financial control, automated billing, communication structure, and legal protection.

hero.subtitle: The Neurora Operating System combines the full takeover process with financial control, automated administration, legal structure, documentation, communication, and daily operational management.

intro.title: From owner approval to daily control, everything follows one structure.
intro.body: Before Neurora takes over, the property follows a clear approval and documentation process. After takeover, the operating system brings together communication, billing, suppliers, records, bank account visibility, automation, and legal structure.
intro.panelBody: This page combines the takeover process with the Neurora Operating System details, so owners can see both the approval steps and the management structure that runs after takeover.

afterTakeover.title: What happens once Neurora starts managing the property.
afterTakeover.subtitle: Once the property moves into active management, the operational structure goes live and the daily management work begins.

items.title: Communication Goes Live
items.desc: Dedicated Viber and WhatsApp groups are created for direct coordination.
items.detail: Dedicated communication groups are created for the Management Committee and residents, giving the property clear channels for announcements, updates, scheduled works, decisions, and follow-ups.

items.title: Monthly Common Expenses Begin
items.desc: Common expenses are issued and tracked through a structured monthly process.
items.detail: Monthly common expenses are issued clearly and consistently. Payments are tracked, pending balances are monitored, and the Management Committee can maintain visibility over the collection process.

items.title: Suppliers Are Coordinated
items.desc: Cleaning, maintenance, utilities, repairs, amenities, and landscaping are organized.
items.detail: Suppliers and contractors connected to the property are coordinated through one management structure, helping cleaning, maintenance, utilities, repairs, amenities, and landscaping stay organized.

items.title: Records Are Maintained
items.desc: Payments, expenses, decisions, minutes, and operational updates are documented.
items.detail: Important property records are maintained in an organized way, including payments, expenses, decisions, minutes, supplier matters, operational updates, and other property-related documentation.

financial.title: The property keeps control of its money.
financial.body: Every apartment building or residential complex has its own Bank of Cyprus account in the Management Committee's name. Funds remain with the client, not with Neurora. This gives the Management Committee visibility, control, and traceability over the property's finances.

items.title: Own Bank Account
items.desc: Each property has its own bank account in the Management Committee's name.
items.detail: The property operates through its own dedicated Bank of Cyprus account in the Management Committee's name, helping ensure that the money remains connected to the property.

items.title: No Pooled Funds
items.desc: Property funds are not mixed with company money or other properties.
items.detail: The property's funds are not pooled with other buildings or company operating funds, supporting clearer accountability and stronger financial separation.

items.title: Full Visibility
items.desc: Income, expenses, payments, and balances are easier to track.
items.detail: The Management Committee can maintain visibility over income, expenses, payments, and balances, helping decisions be made with better financial clarity.

cta.title: Ready to understand what your property needs?
cta.body: Tell us about your apartment building or residential complex and we will prepare a clear proposal based on its real operational needs.

items.title: Payments are delayed or unclear
items.detail: Without structured billing, owners receive inconsistent invoices, miss payment deadlines, or are unsure what they're being charged for. Cash flow becomes unpredictable and the property cannot plan ahead.

items.title: No visibility over finances
items.detail: Without a dedicated bank account and proper reporting, owners have no way to see where money is going. Funds get pooled, mixed with other properties, or controlled entirely by a single individual.

items.title: Maintenance issues are handled too late
items.detail: Reactive maintenance leads to escalating problems and unnecessary costs. Without scheduled oversight and a coordinated contractor network, small issues become expensive emergencies.

items.title: Communication is slow or ignored
items.detail: When residents have to chase responses or rely on informal channels, trust erodes. Important updates are missed, requests fall through the cracks, and owners feel disconnected from their own property.

items.title: Decisions are undocumented
items.detail: Verbal agreements and informal approvals create disputes, ambiguity, and legal exposure. Without proper minutes and resolutions, the property has no record of what was decided or by whom.

items.title: No clear responsibility or accountability
items.detail: When no one owns the operational outcome, problems persist indefinitely. A structured system assigns clear responsibility, measurable standards, and accountability at every level.

postConstruction.title: From construction handover to presentation-ready property.
postConstruction.subtitle: After construction, properties are often left with dust, debris, residue and marks across apartments, entrances, common areas and shared facilities. Neurora prepares the entire property so it is clean, organized and ready to be shown, handed over or occupied.

visual.beforeText: Dust, debris, residue and unfinished presentation across the property.
visual.afterText: Apartments, entrances, common areas and shared spaces prepared for a better first impression.

cards.title: Debris & Dust Removal
cards.desc: Construction dust, packaging residue and leftover debris cleared from apartments and shared spaces.
cards.detail: Post-construction cleaning focuses on removing the visible and practical mess left after works are completed. This includes construction dust, packaging remains, small debris, residue, marks and dirt from apartments, entrances, corridors, staircases, lifts, common areas and shared facilities so the property no longer feels like a construction site.

cards.title: Full Property Preparation
cards.desc: Apartments, entrances, corridors, lifts, staircases and shared areas prepared for first use.
cards.detail: The service covers the areas owners, residents and visitors see and use: apartments, entrances, corridors, staircases, lifts, lobbies, common areas and shared facilities. The goal is to make the whole property clean, presentable and ready for handover, viewings or first occupation.

cards.title: Presentation Ready
cards.desc: A better first impression for owners, residents, buyers and visitors.
cards.detail: A newly completed property should not be presented with construction residue still visible. Neurora helps prepare the entire property for its first impression, making apartments, shared spaces and building entrances suitable for owners, residents, buyers and visitors from day one.

solution.title: Neurora replaces chaos with structure.
solution.body: We implement a complete operational system covering finances, communication, maintenance, and legal structure.
solution.footer: Nothing is left unmanaged. Nothing is unclear.

services.title: Everything your property needs. Fully handled.
services.subtitle: One partner. Full operational control.

items.title: Common Expenses
items.desc: Fixed monthly amounts, allowing residents to pay multiple months in advance or set up standing orders.
items.detail: Common expenses are calculated as fixed monthly amounts based on each unit's share. Residents can pay months in advance or set up standing orders, removing friction and ensuring predictable cash flow for the property. No surprise reconciliations, no end-of-year adjustments.

items.title: Cleaning & Maintenance
items.desc: Consistent upkeep of all common areas, supervised against a documented standard.
items.detail: All common areas (entrances, corridors, stairwells, parking, and shared facilities) are kept to a defined cleanliness standard. Schedules are fixed, supervision is regular, and maintenance interventions are coordinated by our operations team rather than left to the cleaner.

items.title: Utilities
items.desc: Utility accounts managed, paid on time, and protected from service interruptions.
items.detail: Electricity, water, and shared utility accounts are operated under structured standing orders. Payments are scheduled, balances are monitored, and renewals are handled in advance, so the property never faces missed payments, late fees, or service interruptions.

items.title: Landscaping
items.desc: Professional upkeep of outdoor areas and greenery, consistently maintained.
items.detail: Gardens, outdoor areas, and greenery are maintained on a defined schedule by qualified contractors. Trimming, irrigation oversight, seasonal care, and replacements are coordinated so the property's exterior remains presentable year-round.

items.title: Amenities
items.desc: Pools, lifts, and shared facilities professionally managed and properly maintained.
items.detail: Pools, lifts, gyms, and shared facilities are placed under structured oversight. Service contracts, inspections, certifications, and routine maintenance are coordinated centrally, keeping amenities safe, compliant, and available to residents.

items.title: Repairs
items.desc: Repair issues handled proactively with coordinated contractor supervision.
items.detail: Repair requests are received, triaged, and dispatched to vetted contractors. Quotes are reviewed, work is supervised, and outcomes are documented. Owners and the Management Committee receive a clear record of every intervention. No informal arrangements.

process.title: One system. Full control.
process.subtitle: A clear operating system from proposal to takeover, financial control, billing, communication, and legal structure.

steps.title: Tailored Proposal
steps.desc: A clear, itemized proposal built for your specific property.
steps.detail: We assess your property's size, units, amenities, and operational needs to deliver a fully itemized proposal. Every cost line is transparent, every service scope is defined, and nothing is left to interpretation. You receive a document built specifically for your property, not a template.

steps.title: General Meeting Presentation
steps.desc: We present the system to all owners. Direct, no scripts.
steps.detail: Our team attends the General Meeting in person and walks every owner through the proposal, the operating model, and the legal framework. Questions are answered directly and on the record, so every owner makes an informed decision.

steps.title: Owner Vote (50%+)
steps.detail: A formal vote is held according to Cap. 224. A simple majority (50%+) is required to appoint Neurora. Results are recorded in the official minutes and made available to all owners. No informal agreements, no ambiguity.

steps.title: Management Committee Elected
steps.detail: Owners elect a Management Committee that legally represents the property. The Committee oversees decisions, approvals, and financial control, supported operationally by Neurora at every step.

steps.title: Legal Documentation
steps.desc: Minutes and resolutions filed under Cap. 224.
steps.detail: All decisions, minutes, resolutions, and appointments are formally documented and filed in compliance with Cap. 224. The property gains a clean legal foundation, protecting owners and enabling proper financial operations.

steps.title: Bank Account Opened
steps.desc: Bank of Cyprus account in the Management Committee's name.
steps.detail: A dedicated bank account is opened with Bank of Cyprus in the Management Committee's name. Funds belong to the property, never to the manager. Every transaction is traceable, auditable, and owned by the property.

steps.title: Operational Takeover
steps.desc: Full operations begin. Communication groups go live.
steps.detail: Neurora assumes full operational control: billing, utilities, maintenance, contractors, and reporting. WhatsApp and Viber communication groups go live from day one, giving residents and the Committee direct access to the team.

communication.title: No tickets. No delays. No middlemen.
communication.subtitle: You message. We act. Direct WhatsApp and Viber groups from day one, with real responses from real people.

channels.title: Management Committee Group
channels.desc: Private channel for financial decisions, approvals, and confidential matters.

channels.title: Residents Group
channels.desc: Announcements, updates, and scheduled works. Full transparency for every resident.

legal.title: Fully compliant. Fully protected.
legal.subtitle: Every action has legal backing. Cap. 224 compliant. Management Committee-based governance. Fully documented decisions.

items.title: Cap. 224 Compliance
items.desc: Every operation aligned with Cyprus law on immovable property.
items.detail: All operations follow the framework set out in the Immovable Property (Tenure, Registration and Valuation) Law, Cap. 224. From committee formation and meeting procedure to financial governance and resolutions, the property operates on a legally sound foundation that protects owners.

items.title: Management Committee-Based Decisions
items.desc: All decisions taken by the Management Committee, never by us alone.
items.detail: Strategic, financial, and operational decisions are taken by the elected Management Committee, with Neurora providing structured recommendations and execution. Owners remain in control of their property at all times, and no decision bypasses the Committee.

items.title: Documented Meetings
items.desc: Minutes, votes, and resolutions properly prepared and filed.
items.detail: Every General Meeting and Committee meeting is formally documented. Agendas, minutes, votes, and resolutions are prepared in compliance with Cap. 224 and filed in an organized archive available to owners, ensuring full traceability of every decision.

automation.title: Nothing gets missed. Nothing gets delayed.
automation.subtitle: Reliable. Predictable. Systemized.

items.title: Standing Orders for Utilities
items.desc: Electricity, water, and lifts paid automatically. No late payments. Ever.
items.detail: Standing orders are configured directly with the utility providers and the property's bank account. Bills are settled automatically the moment they're due, eliminating any risk of late fees, service interruptions, or forgotten payments. Owners no longer rely on someone remembering to pay.

items.title: Invoices on the 1st
items.desc: Monthly invoices sent automatically to every owner on the first of the month.
items.detail: Every owner receives a clear, itemized invoice on the first day of each month, generated automatically and delivered consistently. Payments can be made by standing order, bank transfer, or in advance, giving residents full flexibility while keeping cash flow predictable.

items.title: Fully Itemized Billing
items.desc: Every line explained. Owners know exactly what they're paying for.
items.detail: Each invoice breaks down every charge: common expenses, utilities, maintenance, repairs, and special funds. Owners see exactly where every euro goes, with supporting documentation available on request. No vague totals, no hidden line items.

items.title: Auditable History
items.desc: Complete record of charges, payments, and works, accessible anytime.
items.detail: Every transaction, invoice, payment, and intervention is recorded in a structured archive. The Management Committee can review the full operational and financial history of the property at any time, supporting transparency, audits, and informed decision-making.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: This Privacy Policy explains how Neurora Property Management Ltd collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data submitted through this website.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
body: This website is operated by Neurora Property Management Ltd, a property management company based in Cyprus.
For privacy-related questions, you can contact us at neuroraproperties@gmail.com.

sections.title: 2. Information we collect
body: When you use our contact or proposal form, we may collect the information you choose to provide, including your name, email address, phone number, property type, property name, location, address, year of construction, number of floors, number of units, notes, and any other details submitted through the form.
We may also collect basic technical and usage information through Google Analytics, such as page views, interactions, approximate location, browser type, device type, and referral source.

sections.title: 3. How we use your information
body: We use the information submitted through the website to respond to enquiries, prepare proposals, communicate with potential clients, understand the needs of a property, improve our website, and maintain website security and reliability.
Analytics information is used to understand how visitors use the website and to improve the website experience and performance.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
body: Depending on the context, we may process personal data because it is necessary to respond to your enquiry or take steps before entering into a contract, because we have a legitimate interest in operating and improving our website and services, because we need to comply with legal obligations, or because you have given consent where consent is required.

sections.title: 5. Sharing of information
body: We do not sell personal data. We may share limited information with service providers that help us operate the website, receive form submissions, send emails, host the website, or measure website performance, including Cloudflare, Resend, Google Analytics, and similar technical providers where relevant.
These providers may process data outside Cyprus or the European Economic Area where their infrastructure or support teams operate, subject to applicable data protection safeguards.

sections.title: 6. Cookies and analytics
body: The website uses necessary technologies required for the site to work correctly. These may support basic functions such as security, language selection, form operation, and saving your cookie preferences.

Optional analytics cookies are used only if you give consent. When accepted, Google Analytics may help us understand page views, visitor interactions, approximate location, device type, browser type, and referral source so we can improve the website.
You can accept, reject, or manage optional cookies through the cookie banner. You can also update your preferences from this Privacy Policy page.

sections.title: 7. How long we keep information
body: We keep enquiry and communication records only for as long as reasonably necessary to respond to the enquiry, prepare a proposal, maintain business records, resolve disputes, or comply with legal obligations.
Analytics data is retained according to the settings and retention periods configured in Google Analytics.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
body: Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to request access to your personal data, correction of inaccurate data, deletion of data, restriction of processing, objection to processing, data portability, and withdrawal of consent where processing is based on consent.
You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Office of the Commissioner for Personal Data Protection in Cyprus.

sections.title: 9. Security
body: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal data submitted through the website. However, no online transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.title: 10. Updates to this policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be published on this page with a revised effective date.
